reference_sql:
WITH quarterly AS (
  -- one row per quarter of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('quarter', invoice_date) AS DATE) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS invoices
  FROM invoices
  WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('quarter', invoice_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT quarter, invoices,
  invoices - LAG(invoices) OVER (ORDER BY quarter) AS change_invoices
FROM quarterly

  WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

FROM quarterly q
LEFT JOIN quarterly p ON p.quarter = q.quarter - INTERVAL 3 MONTH
other_way.tradeoff: Joining each quarter to the one three months earlier states the step by date, but LAG is shorter when every quarter has a row.
